signal: Trovata launched CORP$, a stablecoin treasury service with Paxos, and extended its Series B with $9M from State Street and PNC

email.body1:
Daniel, saw Trovata launch CORP$ with Paxos and extend the Series B with State Street and PNC.

A new product plus fresh capital usually means more in-market corporate finance teams fit your ICP than sales can personally cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Trovata off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Daniel, quick follow-up for Trovata.

Launching a new product line and raising usually means the pipeline target jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Trovata needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Daniel, last bit of proof for Trovata.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Trovata's reply rate likely compares to other fintech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Daniel, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Shipping a new product right after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a fintech motion? I will tailor it to Trovata either way.
